Soon, Badnaam shows up as Dimple, his wife, with tea and tells everyone that her husband has gone to his hometown. Ashok smuggles oranges into the station which are spiked with alcohol and people at the station, not knowing about it, eat them.

videos.title: Ashok Hibernates For 20 Years
videos.overview: Maddam Sir and Karishma ask Ashok to bring ice for them. They lock him inside the freezer as soon as he gets in. The next day, he comes out and gets surprised to find everyone old. He finds he has been hibernating for 20 years. It reduces Ashok to tears when he finds his wife begging for money and his son becoming a drunk like him.

videos.title: Best Police Thana
videos.overview: Ashok gets a glimpse into the future where his family will have to suffer because of his drinking habit. He agrees to quit drinking and admits himself to a rehabilitation centre. Later, Maddam Sir reveals that there will be a competition to see which police station is the best in Lucknow.

videos.title: Bulbul Pandey Insults The Women's Police Station
videos.overview: Karishma and her team successfully ambush the kidnapper, who reveals that he did it because the victim asked him to do so. Later, Bulbul Pandey arrives at the station to make fun of the work they do in the women's police station.

videos.title: Saas-bahu Problems
videos.overview: Maddam Sir requests DSP Anubhav to go shopping with her and act like a couple for a day. Back at the station, Karishma and Pushpa try to solve the mother-in-law and daughter-in-law's quarrel.

videos.title: The Saas-bahu Role Reversal
videos.overview: Maddam Sir removes Karishma and Pushpa from the Saas-Bahu case and takes the lead herself. Bulbul Pandey arrives at the station to watch all of them fail. Later, Karishma and Pushpa end up becoming participants of Maddam Sir's "Saas-Bahu Debate", but now their roles are reversed.

videos.title: Billu - The Writer
videos.overview: Maddam Sir finally pulls out her principal weapon to put an end to the saas-bahu case. Later, Billu writes a movie script about two female police officers who resemble Maddam Sir and Karishma. He also pitches his story to a movie director, who is intrigued by the concept.

videos.title: Billu Needs His Family
videos.overview: Maddam Sir and Karishma find out that Shambu Spielberg has made a movie based on their real-life characters, a story that was pitched to him by Billu. Later, Billu confronts him but he is put behind bars in Bulbul's station. Maddam Sir is now determined to teach Shambu a lesson.

videos.title: Haseena and Karishma Role Reversal
videos.overview: Maddam Sir and Karishma go undercover as they decide to audition for their roles. However, both get selected to play each other's real-life characters. Soon, Maddam Sir realizes Shambu records everything on his phone and it might have a recording of Billu pitching his story.

videos.title: Billu is Not Alone
videos.overview: Santosh clones Shambu's phone to find the evidence that will exonerate Billu. However, Bulbul calls Shambu asking him to delete the video if he does not want to get caught. Maddam Sir has to come up with another clever plan to catch Shambu off-guard.

videos.title: Tiger In The Station
videos.overview: Maddam Sir finds everyone busy with their phones at the station. She declares a no phone day at least once a week. Soon, Pushpa receives a call informing her about a tiger that is running lose in the city. Later, the tiger finds its way to the Mahila Police Thana.

videos.title: Maddam Sir Saves The Tiger
videos.overview: Maddam Sir and Karishma pull Pushpa out of the room where the tiger is trapped. Soon, a mob accumulates that wants the tiger killed as it has caused a lot of harm to them. Maddam Sir comes up with a plan to save the tiger and disperse the mob.

videos.title: Maddam Sir Warns Karishma
videos.overview: Bulbul Pandey is diverting all his cases to the women's police station that has caused a fall in the efficiency of the station. Karishma plans to solve these cases privately without registering the FIR to help her station edge ahead in the "Best Police Station competition."

videos.title: Karishma's Private Police Station
videos.overview: Karishma Singh goes against Maddam Sir's order and starts solving cases privately. How will Maddam Sir react when she finds out the things that are happening at her police station?

videos.title: Karishma - The Walking Talking Police Station
videos.overview: Karishma and her associates at her private police station find success in solving crimes. Soon, they are greeted by an intriguing civilian who finds their work skeptical.

videos.title: Whose Side are You On?
videos.overview: Karishma asks Billu to secretly give her a report of every case coming to the police station. What will happen when Maddam Sir finds out the truth? Will Karishma and Maddam sir patch things up?

videos.title: Karishma has Eyes On The Prize
videos.overview: Karishma will go to any extent to help her police station win the 'Best Police Station' award, even when she is not on duty. Will she succeed in keeping the crime rate low?

videos.title: Live For Yourself
videos.overview: Pallavi gets admitted to the hospital as she gets exhausted due to stress and working for the family all day. Maddam Sir comes up with an elaborate plan to teach her a valuable lesson.

videos.title: Karishma is Back!
videos.overview: Karishma apologises to Maddam Sir and rejoins her duty. However, she is more determined than ever to win the "Best Police Station" competition.

videos.title: Station's Future Looks Bleak
videos.overview: Santosh pulls out all statistics to find out that their station lies at the bottom of the charts. Maddam Sir reveals that if things remain unchanged, then there will be no future for their Women's Police Station.

videos.title: Close Calls For Karishma
videos.overview: Karishma manages to make narrow escapes multiple times, however, she is still headstrong about winning the competition.

videos.title: Finding Qayamat
videos.overview: Everyone lays down an elaborate plan to teach Sanjay a lesson. Later, Sunny shows up with information about Qayamat. Will Maddam Sir find out the truth about her?

videos.title: Two Cases One Qayamat
videos.overview: Maddam Sir gives Billu the task to resolve two cases at the same time. Later at night, Qayamat shows up at the station and helps with the cases in her style.

videos.title: Tara or Sitara - Who Came First?
videos.overview: Qayamat's threats fell on deaf ears when both Tara and Sitara start fighting again. Maddam Sir decides to find out who's shop was opened first, Tara's or Sitara's.

videos.title: Karishma's Night Duty
videos.overview: To deal with the Qayamat situation, Maddam Sir asks Karishma to work on the night shifts. Later, DSP Anubhav has to step in to deal with the Tara-Sitara case.

videos.title: Pushpa's Vision
videos.overview: Pushpa starts losing her vision and finds it difficult to go through her daily duties. She finds a workaround so she can complete her tasks as usual. Soon, a situation arises that lands her in trouble.

videos.title: Qayamat's Justice
videos.overview: Pushpa keeps getting into trouble as she is given more tasks to take care of. Soon she gets into a situation she can't get herself out of.

videos.title: Pushpa's Secret is Out
videos.overview: After finding Qayamat's phone, Maddam Sir is sceptical about why she left the phone on a terrace. Later, Maddam Sir finds Pushpa's secret. Will Pushpa lose her job with her eyesight?

videos.title: Maddam Sir Confronts Pushpa
videos.overview: Maddam Sir scolds Pushpa and Cheetah for hiding the truth about her medical issues from her. She also discovers that Pushpa has been taking the wrong medicine and everyone in the team should help her during this phase.

videos.title: The Best Police Station Award
videos.overview: Bulbul Pandey arrives at the Mahila Police Thana before the award ceremony to rub their defeat on their faces. Later, Qayamat visits Bulbul Pandey to register an FIR at his station.

videos.title: The Holi Madness
videos.overview: Maddam Sir makes it clear that she will not grant leave to anyone as things get out of hand during the Holi celebration. Later, during her regular patrolling, Karishma is splashed by a water balloon that affects her hearing.

videos.title: Santosh's Fears
videos.overview: Santosh talks to Maddam Sir and tells the truth about taking leave on every Holi. Later, Karishma is convinced that if she is slapped hard enough she can regain her hearing.

videos.title: The Holi Hangover
videos.overview: Maddam Sir lets Sonu and his friends go as she has a plan to teach them a lesson. The next day, the team goes undercover to threaten Sonu and his friends.

videos.title: Maddam Sir is Hungover
videos.overview: DSP Anubhav is trying to get close to Maddam Sir during Holi celebrations. Meanwhile, Maddam Sir mistakenly drinks three glasses of Bhaang.

videos.title: Maddam Sir Backtracks Her Holi
videos.overview: The team finds DSP Anubhav's phone and notices that there's a bullet missing from the gun. With Maddam Sir suffering from amnesia, the team backtracks her entire day.

videos.title: Finding Dsp Anubhav
videos.overview: Maddam Sir and her team work hard to find one clue after another as she tries to remember what happened on the day of Holi. Soon, they manage to follow the bread crumbs and find DSP Anubhav.

videos.title: Explosion Of Cases
videos.overview: A crowd gathers at the Mahila Police Station to register their complaint against Qayamat. Later, Cheetah stumbles onto a secret room while hammering a nail on the wall.

videos.title: Karishma Walks On Hot Coal
videos.overview: Karishma and Billu are worried as they are left out of Maddam Sir's briefing about Qayamat. Soon, Karishma receives a call from an unknown person claiming to have proof of Qayamat's real identity.

videos.title: Transporting The Treasure
videos.overview: Maddam Sir makes last-minute changes to her plan of transporting the treasure. However, the van still gets intercepted by masked robbers. Will the team be able to get out of this situation?

videos.title: Karishma's Choices
videos.overview: The blackmailer now wants Karishma to personally deliver the treasure. Later, Karishma gives Billu the task of sneaking out with the treasure from the station.

videos.title: Qayamat Caught
videos.overview: Pushpa opens the chest to realise that its contents are missing. Later, Maddam Sir reveals her clever plan to track Qayamat using the stolen goods.

videos.title: The Jewel Thief
videos.overview: Karishma stumbles onto a jeweller who claims that the woman he has captured is a jewel thief. However, due to lack of evidence, Karishma takes them to the station for further investigation.

videos.title: Maddam Sir's Unusual Ways
videos.overview: Maddam Sir's plan backfires on Cheetah when the convict agrees to his marriage proposal. Later, DSP Anubhav tells Maddam Sir the importance of this case and questions her way of solving it.

videos.title: Karishma's Sister
videos.overview: Karishma visits Shivani's house to speak to her mother about the truth of the matter. Later, Maddam Sir reveals that Karishma's sister is coming to the station to help solve the case.

videos.title: Raveena Arrives At Police Station
videos.overview: Karishma's sister, Raveena, arrives at the Mahila Police Station and causes trouble. Later, Bulbul Pandey comes, claiming to have an FIR against Cheetah, and arrests him. Will the team manage to clear his name?

videos.title: Cheetah's Fake Profile
videos.overview: Pushpa and Santosh show Maddam Sir the video they manage to record of DSP Anubhav. Later, Maddam Sir visits Chulbul's station to clear the confusion that resulted in Cheetah's arrest.

videos.title: Freeing Cheetah
videos.overview: Chulbul Pandey challenges Maddam Sir that he will spoil her and her station's reputation no matter what. Later, Santosh visits Cheetah at the lock-up to inform him that they are working hard to get him out.

videos.title: The New Police Thana
videos.overview: The Mahila Police Thana team has been working overtime for the past two months. Karishma takes a mysterious call in the morning and decides to deal with it all alone.

videos.title: Karishma's Police Thana
videos.overview: Everyone at the Mahila Police Thana is worried about Karishma heading her Police Thana. Meanwhile, Karishma discovers the cumbersome problems that her new workplace has.

videos.title: Karishma's Case As Sho
videos.overview: Pushpa and Santosh pay a visit to Karishma's new station, and discover the mess that it is. Karishma plans to listen to no one and solve the case in her way.

videos.title: Fatima's Documents
videos.overview: Karishma scolds her subordinates for the lack of filing system they have in their station. She later shares a dream that she had with Pushpa.

videos.title: Maddam Sir Takes The Case
videos.overview: The boss gives Fatima another opportunity to take the job by calling her to his office alone. Maddam Sir requests Karishma to give her the case as the proceedings have taken a serious turn.

videos.title: Karishma Ki Ek Awaaz
videos.overview: Everyone at the Mahila Police Thana misses Karishma and the strength she possesses. She loses her calm when she finds out that a goon stole her bike.

videos.title: Karishma's Press Conference
videos.overview: Karishma goes on TV to let her bike thief know that they have 24 hours to plead guilty. She later executes her plan to catch the culprit herself.

videos.title: Helping Karishma
videos.overview: The Mahila Police Thana team decides to help Karishma solve her case without letting her know that they helped her. Santosh visits Karishma at her new station to feed her information.

videos.title: Karishma Finds Her Bike
videos.overview: Karishma follows Santosh's advice and follows one lead after another. She manages to find a man who deals with stolen goods, but Madaam Sir believes that there is more to it.

videos.title: Bike Thief Caught
videos.overview: Karishma tracks down the bike thief and drags him down to the Mahila Police Thana. She later confronts Pushpa about the tiffin incident that keeps occurring every day.

videos.title: Case Against Mother
videos.overview: A woman comes to the station to file a case against her over-controlling mother. But there seems to be a debate about who gets to follow up on the case.

videos.title: Helping Karishma
videos.overview: Karishma finds herself at a dead end with her new case. However, she is too proud to ask for help from her old colleagues and decides to solve the case alone.

videos.title: Karishma Ke Totke
videos.overview: Pushpa asks the Saadhu for a way to keep her daughter-in-law under control not knowing that it is Karishma in disguise. Maddam Sir's jeep breaks down on the way to the station and she has an interesting conversation with her mother.

videos.title: Kismat Ka Darwaza
videos.overview: Santosh and Pushpa set up Jaya to follow a few unorthodox steps to help her daughter find a match. Maddam sir teaches her a lesson about blind faith.

videos.title: Blackmail or Social Justice
videos.overview: Chulbul Pandey shows up at Karishma's station and gets insulted by her. A young boy approaches Maddam Sir asking her to do something about his case, or he will make an embarrassing video viral.

videos.title: Learning From The Ladies
videos.overview: The Head Of The Department sends Pandey Ji to Maddam Sir's Chowki to learn her ways of management. Meanwhile, a child from the neighbouring colony puts a case on the department and puts everyone in trouble.

videos.title: Dealing With Aarav
videos.overview: Maddam Sir spots Chulbul Pandey with Aarav and gives them a piece of her mind. She calls her team out so they can talk about the Aarav situation in private.

videos.title: Maddam Sir Threatened
videos.overview: Maddam Sir receives one threat after another and takes the help of their new young boss. They arrest Pushpa, Karishma and Bulbul Pandey, but the threats keep coming.

videos.title: Bulbul's Evil Schemes
videos.overview: Maddam Sir makes Aarav realise the benefits of the lockdown. Bulbul Pandey meets a reporter to hand him a recording that will cause harm to the Mahila Police Thana team.

videos.title: Maddam Sir Meets Karishma
videos.overview: Nawab Sahab's son shows up at the station and asks Maddam Sir to pay the rent. Karishma and Maddam Sir meet at the coffee shop to discuss something important.

videos.title: Karishma Insulted By Press
videos.overview: Bulbul Pandey's plan is set in motion when the media starts insulting Karishma. Nawab Sahab shows up in a cycle and explains his current situation.

videos.title: Karishma Won't Ask For Help
videos.overview: DSP Anubhav calls Karishma and Maddam Sir to his office for an important meeting. Maddam Sir and Pushpa arrange to meet Raees after their duty hours to counsel him.

videos.title: Karishma Warns Maddam Sir
videos.overview: Karishma hands over an FIR to Maddam Sir and warns her to stay away from her case. She later beats up Raees for misbehaving.

videos.title: Trust Goes Both Ways
videos.overview: Bulbul Pandey probes Santosh regarding the truth about Pushpa's wedding. Karishma Singh asks Maddam Sir to trust her and tell her the truth about the case.

videos.title: Pakadwa Vivah
videos.overview: Karishma tries to teach her new team some basic etiquettes. A girl shows up at the station claiming that she and her husband got forced into marriage.

videos.title: Masterji Captured
videos.overview: Maddam Sir has to rush to the hospital as her mother has been admitted there. Pushpa manages to arrest Masterji and puts him in jail.

videos.title: Mahila Thana In Trouble
videos.overview: Surbhi goes to the media and lies about the Mahila Police Thana team. Maddam Sir gets worried and tries to come up with a plan to save everyone and get to the truth.

videos.title: Mahila Thana Closed
videos.overview: A masked shooter enters the Mahila Police Thana and threatens everyone. In light of recent stories published by the media, the police department decides to shut down the Mahila Police Thana.

videos.title: Thana Ko Bachana Hai
videos.overview: Maddam Sir asks her team to keep their heads high and prove their worth to the department. The next day, she finds her station locked and breaks down.

videos.title: Anubhav Kidnapped
videos.overview: Karishma meets a guy who claims to be Maddam Sir's brother. Billu, who is undercover, finds DSP Anubhav, who got kidnapped by  Masterji's goons.

videos.title: Welcome Back Karishma
videos.overview: Karishma enters at the 11th hour and saves the Mahila Police Thana team from getting murdered. The Mahila Police Thana gets reopened, and Karishma gets to rejoin her old station.

videos.title: Protest Against Mahila Thana
videos.overview: Bulbul Pandey catches Karishma meddling with his case. He decides to teach the Mahila Police Thana team a lesson.

videos.title: Billu Ki Love Story
videos.overview: Maddam Sir gets Mishti to the station with a ploy to free Cheetah. Karishma and Billu try to inspire Naman to confess his love.

videos.title: Karishma's Personal Experience
videos.overview: A man, without wearing his pants, arrives at the Mahila Police Thana and reports that his laptop got stolen. Karishma uses her personal experience to find a lead for the case.

videos.title: Maddam Sir Proves Her Point
videos.overview: Maddam Sir tells Karishma that she finds something missing in Keshav's case. She gives Karishma a simple task to prove her point.

videos.title: Keshav Gets Fired
videos.overview: Keshav's boss gets on a video call with him and fires him. Maddam Sir promises him that she will help him with his case.

videos.title: Keshav's Boss Apologises
videos.overview: After Keshav's boss fires him, the Mahila Police Thana team decides to teach the boss a lesson. Later, Chandrika shows up at the station complaining about her husband's affair.

videos.title: The Cheating Husband
videos.overview: Maddam Sir asks Billu to keep an eye on Chandrika's husband. Maddam Sir and Karishma disagree upon the facts of their investigation.

videos.title: Dhokebaaz Detective
videos.overview: Maddam Sir comes across the edited and fake photograph of Chandrika's husband. She wants Karishma to handle the situation silently and effectively.

videos.title: Funny Thing About Trust
videos.overview: Maddam Sir sends Billu to lure Chandrika to a trap. Chandrika learns the truth about her husband and starts trusting him more.

videos.title: Finding The Conspirators
videos.overview: Karishma tries to find out who the main conspirator was and is shocked to find the answer.

videos.title: The Matrimonial Profile
videos.overview: The thana deals with a new case where a woman gets shamed for putting her profile up on a matrimonial site. How do our officers help a daughter trying to get her mother remarried?

videos.title: The Officers Go Undercover
videos.overview: Anuradha keeps creating a scene and expects widow traditions to be followed. To teach her a lesson, the officers go undercover. Will they manage to make her change her ways?

videos.title: Scare Tactics On Anuradha
videos.overview: Anuradha gets scared when she is asked to shave her head. She says that the custom of shaving her head, is ancient and she doesn't want to do it. Will she realize her mistake and understand what she has been doing to Shalini for so long?

videos.title: Moving On With Time
videos.overview: Shalini's mother-in-law finally realises her mistake and accepts her remarriage. Meanwhile, Haseena gets to know something that breaks her down into tears.

videos.title: A Broken Marriage
videos.overview: A woman comes to the Police station and tells Haseena that last night was supposed to be her wedding but her fiance did not show up. Haseena promises to look deep into the issue.

videos.title: Haseena's Plan
videos.overview: Haseena devises a plan which involves Karishma taking Ankit and his mother to the Police station for questioning. This makes Purohit furious. After spending a lot of time alone at home, will he finally mellow down?

videos.title: Looking For a House Help
videos.overview: Purohit desperately looks for a house help as he struggles to live all by himself. Haseena however, has a plan for him, will Purohit fall for it?

videos.title: Offering a Bribe
videos.overview: Someone comes into the 'thana' and offers Haseena a bribe. How does Haseena react to this situation?

videos.title: Haseena Regrets Her Decision
videos.overview: Haseena walks up to her boss and tells him that she regrets her decision of giving the tender to a particular company. How does her boss react to this revelation?

videos.title: Vardi Ka Bhaukaal
videos.overview: The Mahila Police Thana officers display teamwork to complete the shoe order. Maddam Sir tells Karishma that she supports Karishma's decision of strong-arming the traitors to scare them.

videos.title: The Bet On Karishma's Anger
videos.overview: The Mahila Police Thana team fights the goons blindfolded to prepare their order on time. Cheetah, Santosh and Pushpa bet on Karishma's anger. Who will win the challenge?

videos.title: Maddam Sir's Mistake
videos.overview: Maddam Sir discovers the CCTV footage of the incident that happened. She realises that they made a mistake and starts working towards fixing it.

videos.title: Karishma Ki Line Hazari
videos.overview: Riya's case spirals out of control as the team is unable to find any leads. Maddam Sir begs for Karishma's punishment to be reduced.

videos.title: Riya Comes Clean
videos.overview: Karishma spends time with Riya to monitor her behaviour. Maddam Sir comes up with an elaborate plan to pull the curtains on the Riya case.

videos.title: Rakhi For Maddam Sir
videos.overview: Maddam Sir comes back to the station after a 10-day long vacation. A woman shows up at the station and starts throwing insults at Maddam Sir.

videos.title: Haseena’s Hallucinations
videos.overview: Karishma greets Maddam Sir and hands her a letter of resignation. She later visits a cellular company for a job interview.

videos.title: Maddam Sir Meets a Psychologist
videos.overview: Karishma distributes sweets to her colleagues and celebrates getting a new job. Maddam Sir consults a psychologist regarding her hallucinations.

videos.title: Haseena's Trouble Continues
videos.overview: Maddam Sir calls Pushpa in the middle of the night to check on her and Karishma's well being. The next day, Maddam Sir gets a call from her psychiatrist and rushes to meet her.

videos.title: Karishma's Replacement
videos.overview: Frustrated by how she gets treated, Karishma decides to quit the police force. Maddam Sir gets asked to interview candidates who can replace Karishma in her team.

videos.title: Replacement Found
videos.overview: The Mahila Police Thana team decides that Barbie Upadhyay's skills make her the best candidate to replace Karishma. Is Barbie as perfect as she seems to be?

videos.title: Barbie's Motives
videos.overview: Kamal calls Maddam Sir to apologise for not delivering the pen drive and tells her that his life is in danger. Barbie goes through Maddam Sir's desk and cupboards. What are Barbie's motives?

videos.title: Narrowing Down On The Lead
videos.overview: Haseena talks to her boss about the man she is looking for who will help her solve a major case. But is there a mole in the department who doesn't want that happening?

videos.title: Locating The Factory
videos.overview: Haseena remembers hearing a siren in the background the last time she spoke to Kamal. She figures out that he must have called from a factory that operated at that time of the night. Meanwhile, Karishma struggles to get used to her new job.

videos.title: Managing Two Jobs
videos.overview: Haseena doubts Karishma for the lapse in the operation and their failure in catching Kamal. Meanwhile, Karishma's boss calls her up and wants her to give more time to her new job.

videos.title: Karishma's Condition
videos.overview: Maddam Sir impersonates herself to be Ritika and sends Karishma's image instead of her own, to track the ongoings of the adult content case, through the app. Will she be successful in nabbing the gang with Karishma's help?

videos.title: Karishma Gives The Audition
videos.overview: The director threatens a girl called Supriya. Karishma sends a voice note to Maddam Sir, requesting her to track and save Supriya from committing suicide. Will Maddam Sir reach in time to save Supriya?

videos.title: Barbie's Doings Revealed
videos.overview: Haseena finds out that Barbie has been tapping all the phones at the police station. She informs Karishma about the same and asks her to not react in front of everybody. What will Maddam Sir do now that she has found out Barbie's truth? Will they nab the gang behind the racket?

videos.title: Maddam Sir's Plan
videos.overview: Haseena and Karishma execute their plan to find out Barbie's true intentions. Will their plan succeed or will Barbie find out about it?

videos.title: Now or Never
videos.overview: Haseena has found out that the headquarters of the entire racket is moving away from them, permitting them with time only until the end of the day. Maddam Sir asks Karishma to promise her to put this case before everything else. Will Karishma succeed in fulfilling her promise?

videos.title: A Baffling Case
videos.overview: An air hostess reaches the police station, stating that somebody cut her long hair short. While Maddam Sir questions her, a few other women show up at the police station with similar complaints. Who is the culprit?

videos.title: Karishma's Last Day
videos.overview: Santosh and Haseena have a conversation. Later, the other members decorate Karishma's desk as their farewell present for her.

videos.title: Haseena Gets Closer to The Culprit
videos.overview: Haseena tracks down a victim and comes close to catching the culprit of the baffling case. Will Haseena get hold of the culprit?

videos.title: Santosh In The Icu
videos.overview: The team takes a massive hit when they find out that Santosh has been in an accident but Maddam Sir suspects that it wasn't an accident.

videos.title: Santosh's Family Arrives
videos.overview: Santosh's family arrives at the hospital and blames Cheetah for their troubles. Maddam Sir takes the case public by holding a press conference.

videos.title: Santosh's Life On The Balance
videos.overview: Santosh's condition worsens in the ICU as everyone tries desperately to help her. Maddam Sir is told that the press conference will be done on live TV.

videos.title: Santosh is Back
videos.overview: The Mahila Police Thana team gets teary-eyed to witness Santosh back in her senses. The team and her family help her with her post-surgery recovery.

videos.title: Bachhiyon Ke Liye Justice
videos.overview: The Mahila Police Thana team is called to apprehend three girls who were shooting a video. Maddam Sir makes it her goal to deliver justice to the girls.

videos.title: Fir Against Maddam Sir
videos.overview: After Maddam Sir's plan to get an apology from Ratan Thakur backfires, she tries to set things right with him. He lodges an FIR against Maddam Sir and the girls.

videos.title: Gilli Dande Ka Khel
videos.overview: Maddam Sir and team help the MLA with his rally and earn his friendship. Karishma's husband's personal trainer comes to the station seeking Karishma's help.

videos.title: The Sensitive Case
videos.overview: Karishma, Cheetah and Santosh find out that Roopa isn't how her husband portrayed her to be. Maddam Sir requests the team to handle such domestic violence cases sensitively.

videos.title: Kaun Saccha, Kaun Jhootha?
videos.overview: Pushpa, Santosh and Cheetah, not knowing that Abhinav is in Maddam Sir's custody, lie to her about catching him. Maddam Sir helps Abhinav get bail and suggests he sort out his misunderstanding with his wife.

videos.title: Abhinav Thrashed
videos.overview: Karishma tells Maddam Sir that she has proof about Abhinav being the victim. Later, Abhinav shows up at the station with multiple injuries.

videos.title: Wrong Account
videos.overview: Roopa has an emotional breakdown and shares her feelings with her husband and Maddam Sir. A man arrives at the Mahila Police Thana and says that he transferred some money to the wrong account.

videos.title: Karishma's Bait
videos.overview: Cheetah and Karishma run into a dead end with the accomplices who helped launder the money. Karishma tries to bait the culprit with the help of Iqbal's new sim card.

videos.title: Karishma's Misunderstanding
videos.overview: Maddam Sir notices that Karishma is taking the case too personally and confronts her. Karishma finds out that she has been messaging the wrong guy all this while.

videos.title: Catching The Fraudster
videos.overview: Iqbal keeps the perpetrator busy on the phone as Santosh tracks her location. Maddam Sir calls Kailash to the station and asks him to apologise to his wife.

videos.title: Lalach Ka Dimak
videos.overview: Maddam Sir's plan goes smoothly, and Sonia agrees to meet Kailash. The Mahila Police Thana team is determined to catch the fraudster red-handed.

videos.title: Stay Away From Appliances
videos.overview: The city of Lucknow is in a state of panic after a message about electronic devices bursting goes viral. The Mahila Police Thana team is hard at work to find the source of all the accidents and the rumours.

videos.title: Undercover At Chor Bazaar
videos.overview: The fake messages keep the citizens of Lucknow scared of all the electronics. The Mahila Police Thana team goes undercover at the 'chor bazaar' to find some tangible leads.

videos.title: Begum-badshah's Challenge
videos.overview: The Begum Badshah duo send Maddam Sir a video message with the details of their next robbery. Will the Mahila Police Thana Team manage to apprehend these thieves before they disappear into thin air?

videos.title: Radio Station Hijacked
videos.overview: The DSP enters Mahila Police Thana in disguise and scolds Maddam Sir for the indiscipline of her team. An RJ rushes to Maddam Sir and tells her that a girl has hijacked his radio station.

videos.title: Aadhi Gharwali
videos.overview: The Mahila Police Thana team interrogates the hijacker about her actions. She forces Maddam Sir to file an FIR against her brother-in-law.

videos.title: The Saali-jija Debate
videos.overview: The DSP orders Maddam Sir to ask Billu to leave the Mahila Police Thana. Maddam Sir has a debate with Ranjit, hoping he will see the error in his ways.

videos.title: Jijon Ka Jija
videos.overview: Maddam Sir seeks Ranjit's brother-in-law's assistance to solve Aliya's troubles. The Mahila Police Thana receives a letter that Cheetah has a hard time deciphering.

videos.title: The Value Of Education
videos.overview: A retired teacher, worried about the future of our country, asks Maddam Sir for help. The Mahila Police Thana team tracks the teacher who is responsible for teaching the students poorly.

videos.title: The Education Scam
videos.overview: Maddam Sir tells the education head that she will expose his scam in the next 24 hours. Soon, she receives a formal notice from the education ministry to hand them the case.

videos.title: Suman Goes Missing
videos.overview: Importance Aparna falls into the trap that the Mahila Police Thana team lays down for her. Maddam Sir asks Karishma to follow up with Suman Verma, who investigated the corruption in private schools.

videos.title: Ladki Ki Izzat
videos.overview: Cheetah tracks down Suman's location and takes Maddam Sir to meet her. Maddam Sir asks Pushpa to counsel Suman's future husband and try to save their relationship.

videos.title: The Stalker Problem
videos.overview: Billu shares his experience and research about the stalker problem that exists in India. Maddam Sir catches the stalker who misbehaved with Suman and makes him confess in front of Suman's to-be husband.

videos.title: Thane Ki Jaadoo Ki Chhadi
videos.overview: Maddam Sir devises a plan to teach Suman's future in-laws a lesson about honour and prestige. The Mahila Police Thana team gets bombarded with annoying phone calls from a group of four culprits.

videos.title: The Noise Complaint
videos.overview: Maddam Sir brings in the four people who had surrounded Karishma, for questioning. Karishma pays Bhalla a visit, who is notorious for playing loud music at odd hours.

videos.title: Bhalla Ki Party
videos.overview: Bhalla continues to party at odd hours and disturbs the neighbours. Can our officers find a way to deal with him?

videos.title: Qaayde Mein Faayda
videos.overview: The Mahila Police executes Maddam Sir's plan and gives Bhalla a taste of his medicine. Maddam Sir's dream of connecting the police with the public finally comes to life.

videos.title: Jazbaaton Ka Dhindora
videos.overview: Maddam Sir goes on live the radio with her show "Qaayede Mein Rahiye, Faayde Mein Rahiye". After Maddam Sir asks Karishma to let the kids go with a warning, they almost get into an accident as they get too involved with their phones.

videos.title: Phone Addiction
videos.overview: Maddam Sir talks about phone addiction on her daily FM programme. She later sets up a camp to help Sanjay and Arushi's phone addiction.

videos.title: Helping The Phone Addicts
videos.overview: The kids promise Karishma that they will attend all of Maddam Sir's sessions for helping them with their phone addiction. After they break their promise, Maddam Sir devises a plan to teach them a lesson.

videos.title: Marriage Material
videos.overview: Pyare Mohan tells the Mahila Police Thana team that he is facing problems finding a suitable match. Maddam Sir devises a test to check if he is worthy of getting married.

videos.title: Finding a Bride For Pyare
videos.overview: Haseena takes it upon herself to find a bride for Pyare and get him married.

videos.title: Diwali Special Competition
videos.overview: Maddam Sir apologises to Pyare on behalf of her team and convinces him that the world must know about his hardships. The DSP calls Maddam Sir and Bulbul Pandey to inform them about a special competition.

videos.title: Protecting The People
videos.overview: Maddam Sir gathers the Mahila Police Thana team and explains their roles in keeping the people safe during the celebration. Karishma challenges Maddam Sir that she will win the competition by any means necessary.

videos.title: The Kaccha Baniyan Gang
videos.overview: Karishma apprehends the members of 'Kaccha Baniyan Gang' and drags them to the station. The Mahila Police Thana team is shocked when Bulbul Pandey calls Maddam Sir to inform her that she has lost the competition.

videos.title: Mahila Suraksha
videos.overview: Karishma and Pushpa manage to save a woman constable from her kidnappers. The DSP calls Maddam Sir to talk about women's safety.

videos.title: Bomb On Pushpa
videos.overview: Maddam Sir answers Pushpa's phone, who is strapped to a bomb, and negotiates with the culprit. The Mahila Police Thana team tries to track the bomber but to no avail.

videos.title: Vardi Ke Liye Tyag
videos.overview: Maddam Sir gets emotional about all the sacrifices she had to make for her job. With Pushpa's life on the line, the Mahila Police Thana team uses all their might to look for the culprit.

videos.title: The Bomb Scare
videos.overview: With only two minutes left for the bomb to explode, everyone gets anxious. After the bomb is diffused, the Mahila Police Thana team uses all its resources to find the culprit.

videos.title: The 90 Day Trial
videos.overview: The DSP informs the team that his decisions are inspired by the safety perspective of female officers. ASI Mira proves her worth, after she rescues Karishma and a kid from a burning building.

videos.title: Dealing With Mira
videos.overview: Mira attacks Karishma in self-defence and chokes her, but Haseena comes just in time to save her. All the officers in the police station struggle to get used to the AI-controlled robot.

videos.title: Tin Ka Dibba
videos.overview: After ASI Mira solves a case within minutes, the Mahila Police Thana team gets worried about losing their jobs. The DSP arrives at the station and scolds the team for not doing their jobs properly.

videos.title: Mira's Night Duty
videos.overview: Maddam Sir hands the night duty responsibilities to ASI Mira. After Mira renders a case invalid, a mob gathers in front of the Mahila Police Thana.

videos.title: Training The Tin
videos.overview: After ASI Mira messes up, Karishma suggests that Mira should work on the case herself. To prove her point, the club owner organises a saree night at her club.

videos.title: The Saree Problem
videos.overview: The club owner proves her point about the saree ban and asks the Mahila Police Thana team to stop bothering her. Maddam Sir confronts Karishma about teaching bad things to ASI Mira.

videos.title: Unbanning The Saree
videos.overview: After hearing Mira's inputs, Haseena sees the logic behind unbanning the saree. She decides to challenge the club owners to a competition to prove that saree is no less than any other outfit.

videos.title: Exposing The Fake Baba
videos.overview: The Mahila Police Thana team come across a case where a 'Dhongi' Baba has been scamming innocent civilians. The Baba gives false hopes about people's fortunes and takes money and valuables from them. Can our officers bust this racket?

videos.title: Mira Powers Down
videos.overview: Karishma keeps the DSP occupied, as the team can't get Mira to the station. Cheetah and Santosh return to the station, believing that the Baba's powers are real.

videos.title: Dhongi Baba In The Lock-up
videos.overview: Karishma drags the 'Dhongi Baba' into the lock-up, but the 'Baba' gains secret information on Karishma and blackmails her. Will the team be able to unravel his secret tricks and prosecute him?

videos.title: Trapping Arjun
videos.overview: Maddam Sir, with Santosh's help, cleverly traps Arjun. Mr Batra personally calls the Mahila Police Thana team to thank them for their service and invites them to a function.

videos.title: Begum Shazia Ki Haveli
videos.overview: Begum Shazia arrives at the station to tell Santosh and Cheetah that someone is trying to take over her property. Things take a spooky turn when the team finds out that Begum Shazia has been dead for 25 years.

videos.title: Paranormal Activity At The Station
videos.overview: Karishma ridicules Maddam Sir's doubt about the existence of spirits. Later, Karishma witnesses some paranormal activities at the police station.

videos.title: Betiyon Ka Haq
videos.overview: Arvind reveals his true identity and intentions to Maddam Sir. The Mahila Police Thana team makes Nawab Sahab see the error in his ways.

videos.title: Mahila Thana Under Radar
videos.overview: Pushpa, who feels guilty for losing Mira, has a pleasant surprise waiting for her at the station. Anti Corruption Bureau arrives at the Mahila Police Thana and informs Maddam Sir that the station is under scrutiny.

videos.title: Maddam Sir's Innocence
videos.overview: Maddam Sir gets framed for taking bribes at her police station. The Mahila Police Thana team has 24 hours to prove her innocence.

videos.title: Clearing The Name
videos.overview: The Mahila Police Thana team discovers that the man who is greedy for the land on which the station is built has set Maddam Sir up. Maddam Sir sends a message to this man through Mira.

videos.title: Maddam Sir's Mother Trapped
videos.overview: Maddam Sir exposes the man who framed her for taking bribes. She sends Mira to her home with the house keys.

videos.title: Mira or Karishma
videos.overview: Mira and Karishma have different theories to the case. Who's theory will turn out to be correct?

videos.title: Mira Goes Undercover
videos.overview: Mira malfunctions as a piece of magnet gets stuck on her. Maddam Sir chooses Mira to go undercover on a mission.

videos.title: Mira's Undercover Mission
videos.overview: Mira succeeds in grabbing Nikhil's attention. The Mahila Police Thana team plan to trap Nikhil redhanded.

videos.title: Mira Goes Missing
videos.overview: Maddam Sir decides to keep Mira undercover till they find out about the missing girls. The DSP finds out that ASI Mira has gone missing.

videos.title: Maddam Sir Loses Her Gun
videos.overview: Maddam Sir reaches the station and realises that her service gun is missing. The DSP suspends Maddam Sir from duty till she brings her gun back.

videos.title: Looking For Maddam Sir's Gun
videos.overview: Cheetah and Pushpa travel around the city in the jeep as Mira scans for Maddam Sir's gun. Maddam Sir confronts the saas-bahu duo who stole their gun.

videos.title: Patrolling Mein Pollution
videos.overview: Maddam Sir forgives the lady who stole her gun and teaches her husband about kleptomania. Mira collects air samples during patrolling and presents her report to Maddam Sir.

videos.title: Karishma Shuts Down Shyam Industries
videos.overview: ASI Mira rings the siren to inform Maddam Sir that Karishma is on the way to Shyam Industries. Karishma shuts down the operations of Shyam Industries for their unethical practices.

videos.title: Proving Karishma Right
videos.overview: ASI Mira has started to mimic other members of the team. Meanwhile, the Mahila Police Thana team infiltrates the factory to collect air samples.

videos.title: Teaching The Factory Owner a Lesson
videos.overview: Maddam Sir and her team find out that the plastic factory has been polluting the air and water in the neighbourhood. They make a plan with the owner's family to teach him a lesson and make him realise the consequences of his actions.

videos.title: Tempo Mein Banda
videos.overview: Maddam Sir and Karishma stumble onto a deaf and dumb man tied at the back of a vehicle. The team manages to find his mother and wife, but how did he get at the back of the vehicle?

videos.title: Karishma Goes Deaf
videos.overview: Mira collects DNA evidence and cross-checks with CCTV footage to help find out who abducted Arpit. To clear the market area of all the civilians, Mira mimics the noise of a blast and ends up harming Karishma's hearing.

videos.title: Arpit Escapes Custody
videos.overview: Arpit manages to escape Cheetah's custody, and Pushpa reports this to Maddam Sir. Problems arise when Mira gets programmed to listen to Karishma's commands, who has lost her hearing. How will Maddam Sir react when she discovers the truth about Aripit's escape?

videos.title: Praneeta Blackmailed
videos.overview: After Praneeta slams her car into Karishma's bike, she begs for an apology. When Maddam Sir calls Praneeta to inform her about her lost earrings, she refuses to collect them. What could Praneeta be hiding?

videos.title: Aurat Ka Sateetv
videos.overview: After discovering what happened, the Mahila Police Thana team loses their calm and starts a hunt for the man who blackmailed Praneeta. Things get out of hand when Mira takes Karishma's hyperbole as a command.

videos.title: Scammer's Last Resort
videos.overview: Maddam Sir asks Karishma to hand over Mira's command before getting into an argument with her about training ASI Mira. The blackmailer threatens to upload all the images he has to the internet if the Mahila Police Thana team didn't let him go.

videos.title: Khane Ki Chori
videos.overview: Two worried mothers walk into the Mahila Police Thana to complain about the stolen food from their daughter's weddings. What the investigation uncovers shocks the team.

videos.title: Chef Mira
videos.overview: Maddam Sir arrests Mira for stealing electricity from a public source to charge her batteries. She plans to make Mira cook the food for Vimla and Kamla's daughters' wedding.

videos.title: Vimla Aur Kamla Ka Hamla
videos.overview: Karishma and Mira get anxious about the case as they are directed to stay in the station by Maddam Sir. Vimla and Kamla face each other in a contest to prepare food for a group of people without wasting anything.

videos.title: Addressing The Tobacco Issue
videos.overview: Karishma and Mira apprehend Satish for buying and consuming tobacco after its ban. To solve the root of this problem, Maddam Sir decides to meet Jaydev, the actor promoting a renowned tobacco brand.

videos.title: Karishma's Reputation
videos.overview: After Karishma insults Maddam Sir for failing to solve the case, Maddam Sir decides to hand over the case to Karishma. With her reputation on the line, Karishma sets out to take on the biggest supplier of tobacco.

videos.title: Maddam Sir Fined 20 Lakh Rupees
videos.overview: DSP informs Maddam Sir that she would have to pay twenty lakh rupees for the damages done on the Jaydev case. Karishma confronts Jaydev about the money, but he refuses to show any leniency.

videos.title: Corporate Torture
videos.overview: With Maddam Sir posted at a different station for a week, a woman shows up looking for her. She claims that her daughter-in-law, Nisha, appears to be scared of something from the past week. When Karishma discovers about Nisha's situation, she makes it her purpose to help her.

videos.title: Paneer Ka Tukda
videos.overview: Karishma plans to bait Nisha's employers by setting up a company called Timeless Publications. Karishma and Santosh later set up a fake meeting to track their location.

videos.title: The Missing Bride
videos.overview: Sapna's worried parents tell Karishma that their daughter has disappeared just before the wedding. Karishma meets Sapna's fiance and finds out that he has no idea about her absence. Where is Sapna?

videos.title: The Team Gets Divided
videos.overview: Cheetah lies to Karishma about Santosh and Sapna's whereabouts. Karishma plans to bait Sapna out by broadcasting fake news about her parents' accident.

videos.title: Sapna Ke Sapne
videos.overview: Sapna takes the harsh decision of getting married and asks Karishma to leave. Karishma gains the support of her team when she decides to solve the case with her emotions.

videos.title: Kidnapping On New Year's Eve
videos.overview: It is New Year's eve and the Mahila Police Thana team is busy at work. Soon they receive a phone call from Trisha Gulati telling them that she has been kidnapped. Karishma and her team race against time to save Trisha from the hands of the kidnapper.

videos.title: No Laat Sirf Jazbaat
videos.overview: Sumukhi is brought to the Mahila Police Thana after she gives them an SOS message. The team divides into two parts and begin their investigation from two different angles.

videos.title: Sharma Pakkda Gaya
videos.overview: The Mahila Police Thana team recreates the night Sumukhi was molested to find something they might have missed. As Karishma chases a boy from Sumukhi's school, Cheetah calls Karishma to tell her that they have caught Mr Sharma red-handed.

videos.title: A Trap For Sumukhi
videos.overview: Karishma calls Maddam Sir seeking her advice on the Sharma case. She lays a trap for Sumukhi and her mother. Will the truth come out?

videos.title: Sumukhi Goes Missing
videos.overview: Rahul kidnaps Sumukhi and believes he will get away with kidnapping and molestation. Soon, Karishma and her team discover Sumukhi and her mother's schemes and teach them a lesson.

videos.title: Happy Birthday Maddam Sir
videos.overview: Karishma decides to wish Maddam Sir on her birthday through a video message. A man named Satya Choubey leaves his hard disc under Maddam Sir's protection before getting caught by some goons.

videos.title: Maddam Sir Gets Followed
videos.overview: As Maddam Sir's mother asks her to get married, she hears the news that Satya has committed suicide. On her way to work, Maddam Sir notices that two men on bikes are following her. What could be the mess that Maddam Sir has gotten herself into?

videos.title: Maddam Sir Ko Khatra
videos.overview: The old DSP, Anubhav Singh, calls Maddam Sir and tells her that the hard disc she has contains a list of all secret agents. With her life in danger and the threat of losing confidential information to the country's enemies, how will Maddam Sir save the day?

videos.title: The Team In Tatters
videos.overview: The Mahila Police Thana team receives Maddam Sir's heartwarming message through Mira. She later explains that being a machine, even she experiences pain.

videos.title: Mira Hacked
videos.overview: Pushpa impersonates Maddam Sir to answer the DSP's call. Mira discloses that she was hacked earlier and was ordered to kill Maddam Sir.

videos.title: Karishma Reaches Mumbai
videos.overview: The DSP decides to send Karishma Singh to Mumbai to meet the manufacturers of ASI Mira. However, when she reaches Mumbai, she is greeted by a troublemaker who has caused a traffic jam. What surprise awaits Karishma in Mumbai?

videos.title: Maddam Sir Ki Hamshakal
videos.overview: After meeting Maddam Sir's lookalike, Karishma asks Santosh to gather all the information about Urmila Mahadev Mhatre. Karishma and Pushpa visit Urmila at her vada pav stall.

videos.title: Urmila Ke Andar Ka Desh Bhakt
videos.overview: After Urmila disagrees to help them, Pushpa and Karishma try an alternate method to persuade her. Will she agree to travel to Lucknow? If she does, will she be able to step in Maddam Sir's shoes?

videos.title: The Ways Of Maddam Sir
videos.overview: The Mahila Police Thana team tries to teach Urmila how Maddam Sir would walk and talk. With goons sent to assassinate Maddam Sir, Karishma leaves Urmila's side to visit the headquarters.

videos.title: Urmila Gets Out Of Hand
videos.overview: When Urmila is nowhere to be found in the house, Karishma and Pushpa go out to look for her. The Mahila Police Thana team gets worried about Urmila's unpredictable behaviour.

videos.title: Urmila Helps The Team
videos.overview: The Mahila Police Thana team gets multiple complaints of property thefts, and Urmila takes it upon herself to help the poor. With her out in the field, the goons sent to kill Maddam Sir make their move.

videos.title: Karishma - a Mole?
videos.overview: The goons receive yet another dangerous task from their captain. After Maddam Sir receives a disturbing call from her superior, she suspects Karishma to be a mole. Will Maddam Sir manage to find the truth?

videos.title: Urmila Aur Karishma Ka Idea
videos.overview: To determine whose idea is better, Urmila and Karishma pitch their plans to the team. The investigation leads the team to discover that the stall owners were a victim of jealousy.

videos.title: Kalewa Hua Chori
videos.overview: After Karishma gets shot, Maddam Sir keeps breaking Urmila's character, which makes the team suspicious. Later, a woman calls the team to report that the 'kalewa' sent by her parents has been stolen.

videos.title: Kaleja Chor
videos.overview: Urmila tells Pushpa to prepare another 'kalewa' so they can trap the thief. Karishma gets furious when she finds that Pushpa has been following Urmila's orders. Will the team manage to catch the 'kalewa' thief?

videos.title: Who is Stronger?
videos.overview: Maddam Sir walks into Cheetah and Santosh, looking through her belongings at the station in the middle of the night. Urmila gets into a fight with Iqbal and Badnaam about which one of the genders is stronger.

videos.title: Bolti Band App Ka Keher
videos.overview: Karishma drives around the city, inviting everyone to the Mahila Police Thana for the Republic Day celebrations. Karishma and Maddam Sir visit the DSP, who is busy answering the press' questions about the 'Bolti Band' app.

videos.title: Tiranga Hi Bachayega
videos.overview: The Mahila Police Thana team brainstorms an idea to make the women of the city feel safe after the issued threat by the 'Bolti Band' app. Karishma gives a heartwarming speech during the Republic Day celebration.

videos.title: Bolti Band Karwane Ke Liye Ek Din
videos.overview: The DSP gives Maddam Sir and her team 24 hours to catch the man behind the 'Bolti Band' app. Urmila decides to bait out the culprit by posting her picture in the app.

videos.title: The Man Behind Bolti Band
videos.overview: Maddam Sir gets worried about Karishma doing something rash and hatches a plan as Urmila. Karishma finds out that the phone Santosh was tracking was left unattended in an autorickshaw.

videos.title: Anubhav is Back
videos.overview: After Karishma tells Anubhav about Maddam Sir's demise, he darts straight to Maddam Sir's house to look for the hard disk. Maddam Sir also receives new intel about the mole in the department. What action will she take to confirm this new piece of information?

videos.title: Shauchalay Hua Gayab
videos.overview: Urmila takes it upon herself to find the people responsible for building a public toilet that does not exist. Unaware that Maddam Sir is still alive, Anubhav takes it upon himself to uncover the truth about Urmila.

videos.title: Shauchalay Ki Khoj
videos.overview: The press gathers in front of the Mahila Police Thana and demands to know what actions they are going to take to find the public toilet. The corrupt government officials make matters worse for the team by complaining to the DSP about their unconventional working methods.

videos.title: Urmila's Mumbai Food Festival
videos.overview: To save everyone's job, Maddam Sir comes up with the idea of inviting the government official as a chief guest to a food festival. When the official has to use a bathroom in the middle of the festival, he sympathises with the general public's need for it.

videos.title: Koodedaan Mein Paisa
videos.overview: A man trying to steal a public dustbin flees from the site when he spots Santosh and Cheetah. Maddam Sir decides to keep the hard disk hidden till she uncovers the mystery behind it.

videos.title: Koodedaan Ka Paisa Gayab
videos.overview: Judging from the man's desperation to find his money, Karishma believes he is in trouble and is determined to help him. Maddam Sir gets wary of Karishma when she meets Anubhav outside the police station.

videos.title: Chaabi Ka Raaz
videos.overview: Karishma hands over Maddam Sir's key to Anubhav, hoping that he will keep it safe. The Mahila Police Thana team sets up a trap to catch the kidnapper. Will they manage to catch him and save Gopal?

videos.title: Chor Police Khelna Banta Hai
videos.overview: When the team finds out about Gopal's intentions, Maddam Sir decides to take it upon herself to teach him a lesson. Sunita, who introduces herself as a maid, complains about her new abusive employer to the Mahila Police Thana team. How will Karishma handle this sensitive issue?

videos.title: Pushpa's Maid Mission
videos.overview: Anubhav asks Urmila to help him get into Maddam Sir's locker. Karishma sends Pushpa as an undercover maid to help Sunita get justice.

videos.title: Maid Ya Readymade
videos.overview: When Pushpa's undercover mission fails, Maddam Sir decides to step up and solve the case with a twist. The Mahila Police Thana team sets up a trap for Sunita's employer. Will they manage to open her eyes to her cruelty?

videos.title: The Runaway Groom
videos.overview: Anubhav overhears Billu's conversation with Sajan and gets suspicious about Urmila's origins. Three women show up at the station complaining about Amar, who called to the same destination to get married and disappeared. How will the Mahila Police Thana Team track this fraudster?

videos.title: Anubhav to The Rescue
videos.overview: Anubhav arrives in the nick of time to save Maddam Sir from the assassins who were sent to kill her. Karishma and Maddam Sir find Amar's sister and bring her in for questioning. Will she help the team find Amar?

videos.title: Ek Kaddam Ki Doori
videos.overview: When Karishma loses all hopes to capture the fraudster, Maddam Sir suggests a new plan of action. They visit Amar's sister and try to get her to spill the beans. Will the Mahila Police Thana team figure out Amar's secret?

videos.title: Amar Mil Gaya
videos.overview: Before she could blow her cover, Maddam Sir finds and takes the truth serum antidote. The Mahila Police Thana decide to flush out the fraudster by posing Sajan as Amar. Will this new plan succeed?

videos.title: Naya Tota Paal Liya
videos.overview: An extremely worried man shows up at the Mahila Police Thana and begs everyone to save the life of his pet parrot. Anubhav continues to interrogate Sajan and Billu with the hopes of finding more intel on Urmila.

videos.title: Tota Hua Giraftaar
videos.overview: Haseena Malik secretly takes away the parrot out of its cage in jail, initiating commotion the following morning. Karishma and the others set out in search of the parrot, and later present a duplicate one before its owner.

videos.title: Thane Mein Shaadi
videos.overview: Maddam Sir makes the owner of the parrot and his wife realise the mistake they had been making. Anubhav realises that Haseena Malik has been lying all along. Later, Karishma and Haseena decide to help a couple get married.

videos.title: Anubhav's Surprise For Haseena
videos.overview: Haseena is surprised to see her mother waiting for her as she enters her house. With Swati having fled the scene, how will Karishma keep her promise of getting the couple married before the sacred fire burns out ?

videos.title: Taking It to The Radio
videos.overview: The Mahila Thana team looks for Swati everywhere, as the groom paces around restlessly. Finally, the team decides to get their message across through a Radio Show.

videos.title: Khoon Toh Khoon Hota Hai
videos.overview: The groom's mother falls unconscious during the ceremony, kicking Haseena and Karishma's plan into action. Later, Haseena rushes home after being anonymously informed of her mother's accident.

videos.title: Do Din Mei Paisa Double Scheme
videos.overview: A group of people lodge a complaint for being scammed online and put the blame on constable Santosh. What is the scheme and is Santosh involved in it?

videos.title: A Plan to Save Santu
videos.overview: Everyone at the Mahila Police Thana tries to cheer up Santosh but in vain. Maddam Sir comes up with a plan to get Santosh out of the scam she has been associated with. Will the Mahila Police Thana succeed in saving Santosh?

videos.title: International Pop Star
videos.overview: Santosh is dressed as an international pop star and Karishma comes up with a plan to nab the culprits. Will Maddam Sir and the team find them?

videos.title: Maddam Sir Ka Sach
videos.overview: DSP Anubhav threatens Maddam Sir, and she reveals her identity. She tells Anubhav about her secret mission. Later, a man comes to the Mahila Police Thana to lodge a complaint.

videos.title: Anubhav Wants The Necklace
videos.overview: DSP Anubhav tortures Sajan and asks him where the necklace is until he breaks down and reveals the location. At the location, Anubhav comes face to face with Haseena Malik and they have a physical altercation.

videos.title: Aise Kaise Sweekar Karu
videos.overview: Sajan tells Haseena about his doubt of Anubhav being his kidnapper. Later, the Mahila Thana team makes Gopaldas realise and rectify his mistake.

videos.title: Same Sapna Aaya
videos.overview: Rohit, a man who dreams of his wife murdering him, approaches the Mahila Police Thana team for help. Later, Rohit's psychiatrist visits the police station to clarify a few things. What is the truth?

videos.title: Bacha Maa Ki Zimidaari Hoti Hai
videos.overview: The Mahila Police Thana team's plan makes Rohit confess the truth about his doings. Haseena Malik plans to tell Karishma her truth after two days. Later, Manju, a distressed nurse, files a complaint about her missing son.

videos.title: Saas, Maa Aur Guru
videos.overview: Pushpa lies about Karishma's profession to her Bua-Saas, who pays them a surprise visit. Karishma expresses her gratitude to Pushpa in a shocking manner.

videos.title: The Sanskari Karishma
videos.overview: The nurse is adamant that she wants to share her concern with no one else but Karishma. Things get problematic when Pushpa's Bua-Saas arrives at the station. How will the Mahila Police Thana team handle the situation?

videos.title: Saas Ka Aadesh
videos.overview: The Mahila Police Thana team lies to Pushpa's Bua-Saas to avoid a fight between them. Manju refuses the team's help after they failed her the first time. Will Maddam Sir find a way to help Manju keep her job?

videos.title: Insaaniyat Naam Ki Cheez
videos.overview: Maddam Sir puts Manju in cuffs and forces the team to hear her plan. Manju's husband and Pushpa's Bua-Saas realise the error in their ways and start respecting the working-class women.

videos.title: Mummy Ki Zimmedari
videos.overview: The Mahila Police Thana team is entrusted with the safety of an ancient mummy. Maddam Sir and Karishma are lured out of the station as the mummy gets stolen by a couple of thieves. Will the team manage to retrieve it?

videos.title: Chautala Maddam Ka Swagat
videos.overview: Pushpa and Santosh are excited to welcome their role model, Chandramukhi Chautala to their station. Chandramukhi suggests that they wrap Billu in tape and make him pose as a mummy to lure the thieves. Will her plan succeed?

videos.title: Chandramukhi Se Smartness
videos.overview: Pushpa tries to beg Chandramukhi to give the Mahila Police Thana team a chance to solve the case. When Chandramukhi arrests the team for drugging her, Karishma and Maddam Sir run away with the coffin. Will Maddam Sir manage to prove her innocence?

videos.title: Mummy Ke Choron Ke Liye Jaal
videos.overview: Karishma sets up a meeting with the mummy thieves by offering them the mummy king. Cheetah's parents force him to get married as quickly as possible. How will he convince them otherwise?

videos.title: Cheetah Ke Dil Ki Baat
videos.overview: Cheetah fails to muster up the courage to confess his love for Santosh. To meet his parents' demands and catch the thief who got away, Cheetah comes up with a plan.

videos.title: Cheetah Blackmailed
videos.overview: Cheetah's newly wedded wife blackmails him to give her a huge amount of money. With the help of the Mahila Police Thana team, Cheetah sets up a trap to reveal the true nature of his wife. Will they be successful?

videos.title: Baby At Mahila Police Thana
videos.overview: Karishma and Pushpa find an abandoned baby with a letter at their doorstep. The Mahila Police Thana team is forced to care for the child while looking for its biological parents.

videos.title: Pyaar Ka Gutargu
videos.overview: After reading the baby's DNA report, Pushpa disowns her son, and Karishma blames herself for the situation. When Maddam Sir investigates the authenticity of the report, she uncovers a shocking truth.

videos.title: Zimmedari Aur Kaam
videos.overview: Karishma takes it upon herself to prove that an individual can maintain a work-life balance. Anubhav plans to return to the Mahila Police Thana, retrieve the pen drive and complete the job that he failed to do the last time.

videos.title: Anubhav Returns
videos.overview: Anubhav returns to the Mahila Police Thana and shouts at Karishma for losing the cupboard key. The team tries to track Maddam Sir, as she decides to run away from them.

videos.title: Karishma's Dilemma
videos.overview: With Maddam Sir's mother at gunpoint, Anubhav makes his escape. Maddam Sir and Karishma manage to catch up to Anubhav. Who will Karishma believe, her brother or mentor?

videos.title: Maddam Sir Loses Her Memory
videos.overview: Maddam Sir wakes up at the hospital with amnesia and shocks the team. A woman named Mayuri shows up at the station complaining about her over-possessive husband. How will the team help her?

videos.title: Helping With Maddam Sir's Memories
videos.overview: Two men arrive at the station to enquire about Anubhav's death. Karishma decides to use Kartik to help with Maddam Sir's memories. Will her plan bear any fruits?

videos.title: Love Ka Overdose
videos.overview: Maddam Sir agrees to continue with her act and find the reason for Mayuri's troubles. Mahila Police Thana team agrees to meet a love baba to find a solution.

videos.title: Vada Pav Ki Rekdi
videos.overview: The Mahila Police Thana team helps Mayuri and her husband in their own special way. Maddam Sir receives Urmila's vada pav stall as a gift. Will this gift help with her memories?

videos.title: Duty Fir Rekdi
videos.overview: Maddam Sir's memories of Urmila returns and she opens her vada pav stall after work hours. The DSP calls Karishma and summons her with Maddam Sir to his office. What trouble could the Mahila Police Thana team have gotten themselves into?

videos.title: Maddam Sir Mein Jhol
videos.overview: Bulbul Pandey is dead-set to prove that Maddam Sir is not who the Mahila Police Thana claims to be. Karishma sets a plan in motion to help Maddam Sir regain her memories.

videos.title: Pushpa Ka Bhanja
videos.overview: Maddam Sir struggles with her identity and has trouble recollecting who she really is. Gajju, Pushpa's nephew, arrives at the station bearing gifts making her a business partner. What could his ulterior motives be?

videos.title: Haseena Malik Ka Commitment
videos.overview: Maddam Sir discovers Gajju's real intentions and blackmails Pushpa to pay her money. Maddam Sir gets herself into more trouble after getting into a deal with Gajju. How will the Mahila Police Thana team deal with Gajju?

videos.title: Haseena Malik Ki Sachhai
videos.overview: The DSP puts Maddam Sir through a lie detector test to find out the truth. Maddam Sir regains her memories and reveals the truth to her team.

videos.title: Two Lies Don't Make a Truth
videos.overview: Maddam Sir plans to continue lying till everyone starts to believe her. Karishma discovers Maddam Sir's plan and decides to take appropriate action.

videos.title: Love Letter Wala
videos.overview: Maddam Sir claims that she has already figured out how to capture the guy who sends love letters. Bulbul Pandey gets his hands on Urmila's ID. Is this the end for the Mahila Police Thana team?

videos.title: Urmila Aur Haseena Ka Connection
videos.overview: Pushpa eats sleeping pills by mistake, and Maddam Sir is left alone to deal with Bulbul Pandey. Maddam Sir comes up with a plan to deal with Bulbul Pandey once and for all.

videos.title: Paani Ki Pareshani
videos.overview: Nawab Sahab brings a couple to the Mahila Police Thana, who need a hall to get married. Water scarcity has taken its toll on the residents of Lucknow. Will the Mahila Police Thana team manage to find a way to help the citizens?

videos.title: Rainbow Water Tankers
videos.overview: The owner of the water tanker walks into the Mahila Police Thana to introduce himself. The water shortage problem takes its toll on the citizens of Lucknow. Will the team manage to uncover Inderjit Padda's dirty secrets?

videos.title: Inder Ka Beta Dhanush
videos.overview: Santosh tries to get Inderjit's son to spill the beans about his father's illicit operations. Maddam Sir kidnaps Inderjit's son and forces the team to follow her new plan. Will her plan work?

videos.title: Shooting At Mahila Police Thana
videos.overview: Nawab Sahab gets a film crew to check out the Mahila Police Thana so he can rent it out for shooting. The crew starts auditioning the Mahila Police Thana team for a role. Who will get selected?

videos.title: Thana Turned Into a Set
videos.overview: Karishma continues her search for the actress so that she can pull Maddam Sir out of the acting role. Pushpa also gets an opportunity to perform an item number in the movie. How will Karishma deal with this mess?

videos.title: Pushpa Framed For Shooting
videos.overview: The Mahila Police Thana team finds itself in a tough spot after Pushpa shoots a crew member by accident. The team dedicates itself to figuring out who could be responsible for framing Pushpa.

videos.title: Urmila Ka Goodbye
videos.overview: The Mahila Police Thana team gives Urmila some parting gifts and asks her to return to Mumbai. She goes to the nearest bar and finds Bulbul Pandey. Will she spill out all of Maddam Sir's secrets?

videos.title: Maddam Sir Ki Vardi
videos.overview: Karishma reaches Urmila's hideout to confront her about the uniform she stole. Can Karishma face Urmila and her goons all by herself?

videos.title: Cheetah's Opportunity
videos.overview: Though Maddam Sir's memories are restored, she decides to use Urmila's personality from time to time. Cheetah gets off on the wrong foot with Santosh's father, who visits her at the Mahila Police Thana. What could he need from the team?

videos.title: Shayari Ki Chori
videos.overview: Abdul claims that Rashid has stolen all his poems and used them to climb the ladder of success. The Mahila Police Thana team begins finding concrete evidence to put an end to this debate.

videos.title: Abdul Ke Liye Insaf
videos.overview: Maddam Sir organises an 'iftar' for Abdul, Rashid and her team. They use this opportunity to find out who is a better 'shayar'. Will Abdul get the justice he deserves?

videos.title: Fans Mein Jhagda
videos.overview: The fans of two cricket teams get into a fistfight in a restaurant. How will the Mahila Police Thana team act to help the fans cheer for their team peacefully?

videos.title: Cricket Fans Ka Passion
videos.overview: Karishma takes on MS fans' challenges to prove that she is one of them. However, things turn bitter when Karishma refuses to bash the rival team. How will the Mahila Police Thana team handle the situation?

videos.title: Sports Ki Spirit
videos.overview: Maddam sir gets her team to play a game of cricket with the fans. However, she refuses to share her plan with the rest of the Mahila Police Thana team. Will they manage to teach the crazed fans a lesson?

videos.title: Bhaag Foot Gaye
videos.overview: Pushpa and Karishma rescue a man who got locked inside his own house. On further investigation, they find that everyone has been ignoring him because of the bad luck that he brings. How will the Mahila Police Thana team help him?

videos.title: Neta Ki Bhains
videos.overview: Karishma invites Ronak to the station to prove that he is not cursed. The buffalo that the minister asked the Mahila Police Thana team to keep, gets stolen from the station. Will the team manage to keep their reputation intact?

videos.title: Duplicate Bhains
videos.overview: Karishma and Cheetah find a lookalike of the minister's buffalo to give to him. However, the minister quickly realises that it is not his buffalo and lashes out at the DSP. How will the Mahila Police Thana redeem its reputation?

videos.title: Nazariya Kharab Hai
videos.overview: Maddam Sir helps everyone to realise that the way they treated Ronak was immoral. A woman named Sudha calls the Mahila Police Thana to complain about her stolen jewellery.

videos.title: Fast Food Ki Aadat
videos.overview: Pushpa takes up the challenge of helping Bunty to get rid of his eating habits. Things take a turn for the worse when Pushpa picks up the wrong diet. How will the Mahila Police Thana team help Bunty?

videos.title: The Blackmailing Bunty
videos.overview: After Pushpa fails, Karishma takes the responsibility of helping Bunty with his fast food addiction. Maddam Sir finds out that Bunty has been blackmailing her team in order to get what he wants.

videos.title: Fast Food Ka Nateeja
videos.overview: Bunty visits the Mahila Police Thana after a month to witness a change in the team. Later at the chemist, Pushpa's medicine gets stolen by a young girl.

videos.title: Goli Ki Chori
videos.overview: Pushpa reaches the station to realise that her pills have been stolen by the girl at the medical shop. Maddam Sir manages to connect the dots and deduces that the girl is in danger. Will the Mahila Police Thana team manage to save her?

videos.title: The Troubled Child
videos.overview: Karishma tries to persuade Maddam Sir to intervene in Amrita's matter despite having no evidence to support their claims. Maddam Sir decides to keep away from the case and let Karishma handle it by herself. How will Karishma help the troubled child?

videos.title: Maddam Sir Ka Exam
videos.overview: Maddam Sir attends her school's reunion, where she faces humiliation from her batchmates. Karishma intervenes as it helps Amrita to realise never to give up.

videos.title: Noisy Neighbours
